Subject: Draft: SAST/DAST, SBOM & patch SLA summary for Evergreen

Rafael / Marissa — drafting the bundle now. Pasting the high-level answers below; I'll attach artifacts in the bundle we send on 10/26.

SAST/DAST program (summary):
- SAST: Static analysis run in CI for every merge request across our monorepo (primary toolchain: Semgrep + internal rules). Coverage target: block merge if any new critical findings; high/medium findings create JIRA remediation tickets with SLAs.
- DAST: Monthly external-facing DAST scans against hosted endpoints (Burp Suite/OWASP ZAP) + ad-hoc pre-release scans for major releases. Internal staging DAST runs in each release pipeline.
- Third-party dependency scanning: SCA runs on every build (Snyk/OSS tooling) with PR gates for policy violations (blocked if very high CVE).

Penetration testing:
- External 3rd-party pentest cadence: annual engagement + targeted retests for significant launches. Most recent 3rd-party summary (Redwood engagement May 2026) attached: pen-test-summary-redwood-202605.pdf
- High/critical findings remediation: triage within 24 hours, mitigation plan within 72 hours; permanent remediation tracked and verified in follow-up retest (typical retest window 30–90 days depending on scope).

Patch SLAs (hosted + recommended for private deployments):
- Critical: 48 hours to mitigation plan; 7 days to remediation where practical (hotpatch or emergency rollout).
- High: mitigation plan within 72 hours; remediation within 14 days.
- Medium: remediation prioritized in next minor release (target 30 days).
- Low: next regular release cadence (60+ days).
- Rollback policy: automatic rollback to last known-good model/runtime artifact; documented runbook and canary gates for major infra patches.

SBOM & dependency inventory:
- We produce CycloneDX-formatted SBOMs per release for the inference runtime and core service images; exports available as CSV/JSON. Example sample: redwood_sbom_sample_cyclonedx_v1.csv
- SBOM includes package name, version, source, license, checksum, and build timestamp.

Evidence & artifacts we'll include in package:
- CycloneDX SBOM (CSV + JSON export)
- SAST rule-sample and recent CI scan summary (anonymized findings)
- DAST scan executive summary (non-sensitive highlights)
- 3rd-party pentest executive summary (redacted where customer-sensitive)
- Patch SLA matrix (patch-sla-matrix.xlsx)

Notes on private / air-gapped deployments:
- For air-gapped customers we provide signed SBOMs and offline patch bundles; updates are delivered via customer-approved channels and validated via checksums and transient-test harnesses. Formal attestations can be provided under a mutual NDA / amendment.

I'll attach the artifacts and a one-page executive summary to the bundle we drop in the shared Drive link.

-Neha
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments (to be included in bundle): redwood_sbom_sample_cyclonedx_v1.csv, pen-test-summary-redwood-202605.pdf, patch-sla-matrix.xlsx

Rafael / Neha — thanks for the early draft. A couple quick clarifications before you finalize: 

1) For SBOMs, does the CSV include transitive dependency depth and resolved license when exported? We want to validate license risk across transitive tree.
2) For private (air-gapped) customers: can you confirm whether you provide a signed attestation for the patch timeline (e.g., signed PDF stating you will follow Critical: 48h / High: 14d for the contracted period)? If not, what is the standard practice?

Also confirm whether the pentest summary can include anonymized proof-of-remediation artifacts (e.g., PR links or sanitized JIRA IDs) — that will help our risk board.

Best,
Lydia

Subject: Final package: Evergreen RFP vulnerability artifacts (deliverable)

Lydia / Trevor — attached is the deliverable bundle we discussed. Summary answers to your clarifications below and links to artifacts.

SBOM exports:
- CSV includes transitive dependency resolution up to 3 levels by default and full resolved-license field for each entry. We include package provenance and checksum. If you need deeper transitive depth, we can generate a full tree on request (estimated 24–48 hrs).

Signed attestation for private deployments:
- We can provide a signed attestation for contracted SLAs under an amendment (standard practice). I'll coordinate with Legal and Security; please confirm the required signer and format and we will add it to the DocuSign packet.

Proof of remediation artifacts:
- Pentest executive summary includes sanitized remediation references (sanitized PR or JIRA refs) and retest status. Where live customer data would be exposed we redact.

Deliverables (attached / linked):
- redwood_sbom_sample_cyclonedx_v1.csv (CycloneDX CSV export)
- pen-test-summary-redwood-202605.pdf (3rd-party exec summary, redacted)
- patch-sla-matrix.xlsx (matrix with remediation windows + rollback runbook)
- SAST_CI_scan_sample.txt (anonymized scan output summary)
- Drive bundle: https://drive.redwood.ai/EG-2026-089/attachments

Next steps: please confirm whether you want the signed SLA attestation added to the DocuSign packet and if Evergreen requires a specific signatory. If you're good with the bundle as-is we can mark this RFP section as responded in the portal and deliver the final package to your security mailbox.

Thanks — Rafael

Redwood Inference
